"''Yes, sir.|The captain and the freighter pilot|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''freighter pilot''' served in a [[Galactic Empire]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. He served on an [[Unidentified Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]], which was [[Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter|attacked]] above the [[moon]] [[Trask]] in [[9 ABY]] by four [[Mandalorian]]s led by [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]. The [[pilot]] was told by his [[Unidentified Imperial captain|captain]] to pull his ship out of Trask's airspace prior to clearing the local harbor's boundaries. After the ship's [[Unidentified Imperial deck officer (Trask)|deck officer]] was [[Death|killed]] by the Mandalorians, the pilot was present for a discussion between the ship's [[captain]] and Gideon. After receiving new orders the captain shot the freighter pilot. ==Biography== {{Quote|How long until we clear the atmosphere and can make the jump to hyperspace?''"
"''We can't climb until we leave the harbor zone, sir.''"
"''Climb now.|The captain and the freighter pilot|}} During the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], the [[freighter]] [[pilot]] served in [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]'s [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], having the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]]. In [[9 ABY]], he piloted an [[Unidentified Gozanti-class Assault Carrier|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]], alongside a [[Unidentified Imperial security officer (Trask)|security officer]]. One [[Standard day|day]], the [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti'' assault carrier]] began departing the [[Water|estuary]] [[moon]] [[Trask]] when it was [[Assault on the Imperial Gozanti freighter|attacked]] by four [[Mandalorian]]s. The [[Unidentified Imperial captain|captain]] of the assault [[carrier]] made his way to the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and the [[security officer]] filled him in just before a [[stormtrooper]] fell onto the bridge window. Thus the [[captain]] had the freighter pilot seal the the bridge. [[File:Trask-officers.png|thumb|left|300px|The freighter pilot stationed in the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier's cockpit with the freighter's captain and security officer.]] The Mandalorians made it inside the [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier]] and proceeded to [[Death|eliminate]] defending stormtroopers. The three [[Imperial officer|officers]] at the bridge listened to reports before the stormtrooper over the comm was killed. The captain then asked the freighter pilot how long it would be until the ''Gozanti'' cruiser could escape into [[hyperspace]]. The pilot replied that the cruiser could not ascend until it left Trask's harbor zone, but the captain had him and the security officer begin the ascent immediately. The freighter pilot listened as the [[Unidentified Imperial deck officer (Trask)|Imperial deck officer]] failed to hold off the Mandalorians and when the Mandalorians' leader [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] exchanged with the bridge, threatening to capture the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier. The captain contacted Gideon in front of the freighter pilot, requesting immediate backup. Hearing the severity of the ''Gozanti'' assault carrier's situation, Gideon implicitly ordered the captain to destroy the assault carrier. The pilot and the security officer exchanged glances in fear, and the captain complied with the moff, shooting the pair with his [[SE-14r light repeating blaster|blaster]]. The captain then attempted to crash the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier but was stopped by the Mandalorians. ==Personality and traits== The freighter pilot was a [[human]] male with [[Color|light]] skin, brown [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]]. He retained a neutral expression while at his post aboard the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier, but gave a fearful glance at the security officer when hearing Moff Gideon give new orders to the captain. ==Equipment== The pilot [[Clothing|wore]] the standard [[Imperial officer's uniform|uniform]] of an Imperial naval officer, including an [[Imperial kepi]] and two [[code cylinder]]s attached below each shoulder. He wore a [[rank insignia plaque]] on his left [[breast]] with two red bars above two blue, which signified the rank of lieutenant.''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]'' ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Bryce-Chapter11-officers.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Alexander Wraith on set as the freighter pilot with director Bryce Dallas Howard and the actors for the captain and the security officer.]] The pilot appeared in "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[2019]] [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]] and released on [[November 13]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}} Credited as "Freighter Pilot," he was played by [[Alexander Wraith]]. ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 3|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' 3]] ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/mando-download-chapter-11-the-heiress|text=Mando Download: "Chapter 11: The Heiress"}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-chapter-11-the-heiress-highlights|text=Bounty Hunting Highlights: 5 of Our Favorite Moments from ''The Mandalorian'' - "Chapter 11: The Heiress"}} {{Po}} *{{InsiderCite|202|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season Two Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Two Companion|reprint=1}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified Imperial freighter pilot}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Piloto de carguero Imperial no identificado |ka=საფრახტო გემის უცნობი იმპერიელი პილოტი }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial Navy officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Members of Gideon's Imperial remnant]]
